name: inspector-panel
title: Inspector Panel
description: Inspect and edit whatever is selected, one item or many: collapsible sections with summaries, compact label/control rows, mixed values across a selection, revert, and an empty state.

meta.intent: Inspect and edit whatever is selected, without leaving where you selected it.

docs: Compose InspectorPanel > InspectorSection > InspectorRow with stock inputs. MIXED is the placeholder for disagreeing values.
